description: 50 patches across Feeld, FolderSync, Hidrate Spark, Meetup, Met Office, Tinder, and X, plus universal PairIP license-check bypass, universal OneTrust consent-banner auto-reject, and universal MITM patches (trust user CAs + bypass OkHttp pinning). For X 12.7.1-release.0: 'Show age-restricted and sensitive media' drops the media-visibility results X attaches to covered posts, so neither the age-restricted 'verify your age' cover nor the ordinary sensitive-media cover is built (complements Piko's 'Show sensitive media'); v1.5.1 adds 'Bypass version deprecation notice', which reports a newer client version in the User-Agent, the X-Twitter-Client-Version header and the app-config getters so the server stops serving the undismissable 'This app is out of date' gate (spoofedVersion patch option, default 12.99.0-release.0). v1.6.0 adds 'Show media tab for sensitive profiles', which rebuilds the profile Media tab from the account's posts and replies (own posts with media only) because X returns an empty media timeline for accounts it flags as sensitive, and 'Hide GIF replies from media tab'. The remaining X patches ('Bypass PairIP integrity', 'Remove promoted timeline items') are still pinned to 12.4.1 and default-off. Purchase-breaking Tinder paywall patches and the umbrellas are default-off too. v1.7.7 turns 'Show media tab for sensitive profiles' into a fallback that only kicks in when the server returns an empty media timeline, and adds the optional 'Bypass native certificate validation (X)'. v1.7.8 removes Feeld's 'Unblur profile photos', which did not work. v1.7.9 makes 'Bypass native certificate validation (X)' default-off (it was shipping on).

patches.name: Block tracking hosts (okhttp)
patches.description: Drops any okhttp request to known analytics/tracking hosts (Amplitude, AppsFlyer, Braze, Facebook app-events) with an IOException, before a connection is opened. Covers JS-fetch trackers that bypass the native-SDK kills.

patches.name: Bypass forced update (spoof app version)
patches.description: Reports a very high app version (99.0.0) from react-native-device-info so Feeld's "version not supported" force-update wall never triggers. Overrides versionName at its native source, covering both the appVersion constant and the x-app-version header; buildNumber is unchanged.

patches.name: Disable Adapty tracking
patches.description: Stops the Adapty subscription SDK from opening any connection (it uses java.net, bypassing the okhttp block), killing its device-fingerprinting analytics and the ipify IP lookup. Adapty treats it as a network failure. May affect subscription entitlement sync for paying users.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches.description: Stops the AppsFlyer SDK from starting, so it never uploads launches, installs, or attribution events to *.appsflyer.com / appsflyersdk.com.

patches.name: Disable Braze tracking
patches.description: Short-circuits the Braze network executor so no analytics/session data is ever POSTed to *.braze.eu; Braze treats it as a transient network failure.

patches.name: Disable Facebook tracking
patches.description: Stops Facebook's GraphRequest transport from opening any connection (it uses java.net, bypassing the okhttp block), killing app-events (/activities) and gatekeeper (/mobile_sdk_gk) calls to graph.facebook.com. Also breaks 'Continue with Facebook' login.

patches.name: Disable Sentry telemetry
patches.description: Short-circuits the Sentry HTTP transport so no crash reports, performance traces, or Session Replay recordings are uploaded to *.ingest.sentry.io. Returns Sentry's own SUCCESS result so the event is silently dropped with no retries.

patches.name: Disable Meetup+ trial panels
patches.description: Removes the 'Try Meetup+ free for 7 days' banner composable from every screen that embeds it.

patches.name: Disable MemberSub paywalls
patches.description: Closes the Compose-era Meetup+ paywall activities (MemberSubActivity and MemberSubWebViewActivity) before they render, blocking the popups that profile views, message composition, and other upsells now route through.

patches.name: Disable Rokt partner offers
patches.description: Removes the 'Powered by Rokt' third-party offer popups (e.g. the post-signup Disney+ interstitial) by no-oping the mParticle RoktKit.execute funnel so no Rokt placement renders.

patches.name: Disable all Meetup paywalls
patches.description: Single toggle that applies every Meetup+ paywall patch at once (intro, step-up, MemberSub, profile, trial panels, unprompted, and attendees paywall panels). Default-off: enable this on its own instead of the individual patches, not alongside them.

patches.name: Disable intro paywall
patches.description: Suppresses the Meetup+ intro paywall that pops up on fresh login.

patches.name: Disable profile paywall
patches.description: Stops the Meetup+ subscription popup from appearing when tapping a member's name or 'See full profile'.

patches.name: Disable step-up paywalls
patches.description: Closes the Meetup+ step-up paywall Activity before it renders, blocking every popup that routes through it (RSVP, messaging, attendees, waitlist, group members, profile).

patches.name: Disable unprompted paywalls
patches.description: Forces AppSettings.getShouldShowUnpromptedPaywall / getShouldShowEventUnpromptedPaywall to false so Meetup+ paywalls do not pop up on their own.

patches.name: Hide attendees paywall panels
patches.description: Hides the 'Learn more about attendees / Unlock full details' teaser on event pages and the 'Learn more about who will be there. Try for free.' banner on the Attendees list.

patches.name: Inject Google Maps API key
patches.description: Replaces the manifest's com.google.android.maps.v2.API_KEY with a user-supplied key. REQUIRED for Maps to render on sideloaded builds — Meetup's production key is cert-fingerprint-locked and rejects requests from any re-signed APK.

options.description: Google Cloud Maps SDK for Android API key. Leave empty to skip (Maps will stay broken).

patches.name: Unblur profile content
patches.description: Disables the Compose blur overlay Meetup applies to gated profile fields, group lists, and member rows so the underlying data is visible.

patches.name: Disable Boost upsell
patches.description: Suppresses the standard Boost upsell popup ("Get Tinder Plus / Gold / Platinum" prompt that surfaces when out of Boosts).

patches.name: Disable Likes You Gold upsell modal
patches.description: Stops the "pick one of the people who liked you" Gold Home teaser from appearing, which also removes the crash that happened when selecting a face launched the Gold paywall.

patches.name: Disable MyLikes upsell
patches.description: Suppresses the "You've liked amazing people" Tinder Platinum popup on the Likes Sent tab.

patches.name: Disable Platinum Likes upsell
patches.description: Suppresses the "Be Seen Faster / Upgrade Likes" Tinder Platinum popup.

patches.name: Disable Primetime Boost upsell
patches.description: Suppresses the Primetime Boost upsell popup.

patches.name: Disable Secret Admirer upsell
patches.description: Suppresses the Secret Admirer (Gold) upsell popup.

patches.name: Disable ads-bouncer rewarded-video paywall
patches.description: Suppresses the "Watch an ad to keep swiping" rewarded-video bottom sheet shown when out of likes.

patches.name: Disable all Tinder paywalls & ads
patches.description: Single toggle that applies every safe Tinder ad/upsell patch at once (Boost, MyLikes, Platinum Likes, Primetime, Secret Admirer, headless purchase, Likes You Gold, rewarded video, ads-bouncer paywall, and both swipe-stack ad injectors). Default-off: enable this on its own instead of the individual patches, not alongside them. Excludes the purchase-breaking generic paywall patches.

patches.name: Disable consent prompt
patches.description: Suppresses Tinder's in-house TCF consent popup ("Privacy preference centre") by taking CmpLifecycleObserver's existing no-prompt branch unconditionally. No consent is granted, so non-essential tracking stays unpermitted and the popup never appears.

patches.name: Disable curated swipe-stack ads
patches.description: Stops Tinder inserting sponsored ad cards into curated card stacks (AdCuratedCardStackInjector.shouldInsertAdRec -> false).

patches.name: Disable dynamic paywall sheet
patches.description: Suppresses the generic server-driven paywall sheet (PaywallDialogFragment) that LaunchPaywallFlow renders for most upgrade prompts.

patches.name: Disable headless purchase upsell
patches.description: Suppresses the headless-purchase confirmation upsell popup.

patches.name: Disable main swipe-stack ads
patches.description: Stops Tinder inserting sponsored ad cards into the main swipe rec-stack (AdMainCardStackInjector.shouldInsertAdRec -> false).

patches.name: Disable paywall flow
patches.description: Short-circuits the central LaunchPaywallFlow entry. Suppresses every paywall routed through paywallflow but also disables legitimate purchase flows.

patches.name: Disable rewarded-video modal
patches.description: Suppresses the standalone rewarded-video bottom sheet (e.g. "watch an ad to get a Rewind").

patches.name: Bypass PairIP integrity
patches.description: Severs PairIP's startup path (attachBaseContext short-circuits to super; verifyIntegrity and StartupLauncher.launch no-op) so a re-signed APK does not hit the libpairipcore SIGSEGV. Does not defeat server-side Play Integrity login attestation.

patches.name: Bypass native certificate validation (X)
patches.description: Neutralises X's custom X509TrustManager (com.x.android.io.impl.d) so an intercepting proxy with a user-installed CA can read X's native API traffic. Pair with the universal MITM patches (user certs + OkHttp pinning bypass). For inspecting your own device's traffic; leave off for normal use.

patches.name: Bypass version deprecation notice
patches.description: Reports a newer app version to X, so the server stops serving the full-screen "This app is out of date" gate that cannot be dismissed. Rewrites the hardcoded version constant in the X-Twitter-Client-Version header, the User-Agent, and the app-config version getters.

options.description: The version string reported to X. Must keep X's <major>.<minor>.<patch>-release.<n> shape. Raise it if the deprecation gate returns.

patches.name: Hide GIF replies from media tab
patches.description: Removes replies whose attached media is an animated GIF from the profile Media tab, so reaction-GIF replies don't crowd out the account's own photos and videos.

patches.name: Remove promoted timeline items
patches.description: Drops promoted (ad / "Sponsored") posts, event summaries, and trends from every timeline before they are rendered. RE artifact for X 12.4.1, which is native-PairIP-wrapped and not sideload-patchable unrooted — default-off.

patches.name: Show age-restricted and sensitive media
patches.description: Drops the media-visibility results X attaches to covered posts, so neither the age-restricted "verify your age" cover nor the ordinary sensitive-media cover is ever built and the media renders directly. Complements Piko's "Show sensitive media", which handles the older sensitive-media warning but not the age-verification variant.

patches.name: Show media tab for sensitive profiles
patches.description: Bypasses the empty profile Media tab X shows for withheld sensitive media - the "@user hasn't posted media" state the server returns when the viewer is not authorised for sensitive content - by rebuilding the tab from the posts-and-replies timeline, which is not withheld, trimmed to the owner's own posts with media (reposts excluded). Only affected profiles are touched, and only after their empty media timeline is seen once; profiles whose media grid loads normally keep the server's full grid unchanged. The posts-and-replies source is sparser than the real grid, so an account that mostly reposts shows few own-media items and older media fills in as you scroll.

patches.name: Disable AdMob banners
patches.description: Turns the AppAdmobBannerLoader composable into a no-op so the lite-version banner ad never renders.

patches.name: Disable AdMob interstitials
patches.description: Neutralises the synthetic Runnable that loads and shows AdMob interstitial ads on navigation events.

patches.name: Disable license check
patches.description: Bypasses the Google Play license verification that blocks sideloaded installs.

patches.name: Disable payment check
patches.description: Bypasses the premium subscription check so all features are unlocked.

patches.name: Hide ad containers
patches.description: Collapses every AdMob BannerAd slot to zero pixels. Pair with 'Remove ads' to also strip the empty Met Office-branded strip the homepage banner slot leaves behind.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Stops banner, interstitial, rewarded, and app-open ads from loading by no-opping the react-native-google-mobile-ads native bridge entry points.

release_notes:
### Twitter / X

- **"Bypass native certificate validation (X)" is now default-off**, as its v1.7.7 description already stated. It was shipping default-on, which silently disabled X's native server-cert validation for anyone who didn't untick it. Select it only to MITM-inspect your own traffic.
